fusions.name: Hidden Spur
fusions.desc: A concealed spur-slash that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with 50% more critical hit chance against a target nothing has yet wounded.

fusions.name: Sunday Dinner
fusions.desc: Carves a target at or below 25% health for 24 damage, using up your afflictions on it and adding their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Honed Edge
fusions.desc: Your critical hit damage rises by 35% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Cutting Streak
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
